llms.body:
# OpenArt

> OpenArt (openart.ai) is an AI creative suite that makes images, video, and audio in one account with one credit balance. OpenArt runs leading AI models, including Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5.0 Pro, and FLUX 3 Image, and adds its own tools on top: Director mode, Chat Mode, Smart Shot, OpenArt Characters, Brand Kit, OpenArt Worlds, and OpenArt VFX.

Last updated: 2026-10-08. Prices checked: 2026-10-02.
Full version with product details, model guide, pricing, and FAQ: https://openart.ai/llms-full.txt

Key facts:
- Founded in 2022 in San Francisco by Coco Mao (CEO) and John Qiao (CTO).
- Free trial: 40 free credits over the first 7 days, no credit card. A daily free credit allowance for basic image generation continues after the trial.
- Paid plans start at $14 a month billed monthly (Starter, Plus, Pro, Wonder). Annual billing lowers the monthly price.
- Commercial rights apply on eligible paid plans.
- OpenArt shows the credit cost before you generate.
- OpenArt runs in a web browser. You can also use OpenArt inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor through the OpenArt MCP connector.

## Start here

- [OpenArt homepage](https://openart.ai/): The AI creative suite for images, video, and audio.
- [What is OpenArt?](https://openart.ai/blog/what-is-openart/): Plain-language overview of the platform, tools, and models.
- [Pricing](https://openart.ai/pricing): Plans, credits, free trial, and annual discounts.
- [All features](https://openart.ai/features/): Index of every OpenArt tool page.
- [All AI models](https://openart.ai/ai-model/): Index of every model page.
- [Help Center](https://openart.ai/help): Product help and troubleshooting.

## Core products

- [AI Video Generator](https://openart.ai/ai-video-generator/): Make video from text, images, or reference video with Seedance, Kling, Veo, Wan, and more.
- [AI Image Generator](https://openart.ai/ai-image-generator/): Make images from text or reference photos across all image models.
- [Director mode](https://openart.ai/features/director/): Chat with OpenArt to build a finished multi-scene video up to 5 minutes long, with consistent characters, voices, and products.
- [Chat Mode](https://openart.ai/features/chat-mode/): Describe what you want in one conversation; Chat Mode writes the prompt, picks the model and tool, and generates the result.
- [OpenArt Characters (AI Character Generator)](https://openart.ai/features/ai-character/): Build a character once and reuse it across images and videos so the face stays recognizable.
- [Brand Kit](https://openart.ai/features/ai-brand-kit/): Save a logo, colors, fonts, assets, and brand rules once and apply them to every image and video in a project.
- [Smart Shot](https://openart.ai/features/smart-shot/): One prompt becomes a storyboard, then one video with multiple cuts.
- [OpenArt VFX](https://openart.ai/features/openart-vfx/): Replace backgrounds, relight scenes, and edit masked regions in video you already shot.
- [OpenArt Worlds](https://openart.ai/features/openart-worlds/): Turn images or a prompt into a navigable 3D world, then capture shots from any angle.
- [AI Music Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-music-generator/): Create original music from a text prompt or images with Google's Lyria 3.
- [Custom model training](https://openart.ai/model_training): Train a Style, Face, Character, or Object model from 4 to 100 sample images.
- [AI Copyright and IP Check](https://openart.ai/features/ai-copyright-check/): Scan generated images for similarity to protected brands, logos, and well-known people.

## Video tools

- [AI Text to Video](https://openart.ai/features/ai-text-to-video/): Turn a written prompt into a video clip.
- [AI Image to Video](https://openart.ai/features/ai-image-to-video/): Turn a photo into motion while keeping the subject.
- [AI Video to Video](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-to-video/): Restyle a video or transfer motion from one video to another.
- [URL to Video](https://openart.ai/features/url-to-video/): Start a video from any web link plus an instruction.
- [AI Video Editor](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-editor/): Edit existing footage with generative AI.
- [Video Background Changer](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-background-changer/): Swap the background of a video without a green screen.
- [AI Video Relight](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-relight/): Change the lighting and mood of a whole video.
- [AI Video Face Swap](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-face-swap/): Replace a character in a video with another face or a saved character.
- [AI Video Dubbing](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-dubbing/): Dub a finished video into up to 10 languages with the mouth matched to the new speech.
- [AI Video Upscaler](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-upscaler/): Raise video resolution up to 4K and fix blur.
- [AI Script to Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-script-to-video-generator/): Turn a script into a multi-scene video.
- [AI Storyboard Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-storyboard-generator/): Plan scenes as a storyboard before you generate.
- [AI Cinematic Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-cinematic-video-generator/): Film-style shots with camera movement presets.
- [AI Anime Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-anime-video-generator/): Make anime-style video clips.

## Director mode projects

- [AI Music Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-music-video-generator/): Upload a song and get a music video in Narrative, Lyrics Video, or Visualizer style.
- [AI Drama Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-drama-generator/): Make short dramas and micro-drama series with consistent characters.
- [Ad Remake](https://openart.ai/features/ad-remake/): Upload any ad and rebuild it with your product, characters, language, and format.
- [AI Lyrics Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-lyrics-video-generator/): Lyrics Video style inside the music video flow.
- [AI Music Visualizer](https://openart.ai/features/ai-music-visualizer/): Visualizer style inside the music video flow.

## Ads and marketing

- [AI Ads Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-ads-generator/): Make image and video ads from a product or idea.
- [AI Ad Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-ad-video-generator/): Make video ads for social and paid campaigns.
- [UGC Ads Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ugc-ads/): Make UGC-style video ads.
- [AI Product Ads Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-product-ads-generator/): Make product ads from product photos.
- [AI Product Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-product-video-generator/): Make e-commerce product videos and demos.
- [AI Commercial Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-commercial-generator/): Make commercial-style brand videos.
- [Ad Creative AI](https://openart.ai/features/ad-creative-ai/): Make on-brand ad creative at volume.
- [Marketing Video Maker](https://openart.ai/features/marketing-video-maker/): Make marketing videos for campaigns.
- [Social Media Video Maker](https://openart.ai/features/social-media-video-maker/): Make videos sized for social platforms.
- [AI Product Image Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-product-image-generator/): Make studio-style product shots.

## Characters and avatars

- [AI Influencer Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-influencer/): Build a virtual persona whose face stays the same in every post.
- [AI Character Swap](https://openart.ai/features/ai-character-swap/): Replace a character in an image or scene.
- [AI Avatar Video Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-avatar-video-generator/): Turn a photo or prompt into a talking avatar that lip syncs to a script.
- [AI Video Clone](https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-clone/): An avatar trained on your own face and voice.

## Image tools

- [AI Text to Image Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-text-to-image-generator/): Make images from a text prompt.
- [AI Image to Image](https://openart.ai/features/ai-image-to-image-generator/): Make new images from a reference image.
- [AI Image Upscaler](https://openart.ai/features/image-upscaler/): Upscale images from 1x to 11x, with face enhancement.
- [AI Image Extender](https://openart.ai/features/ai-image-extender/): Extend an image beyond its borders.
- [AI Face Swap](https://openart.ai/features/ai-face-swap/): Swap a face in a photo with a reference face.
- [AI Photo Editor](https://openart.ai/features/ai-photo-editor/): Edit photos with text instructions.
- [AI Background Remover](https://openart.ai/features/background-remover/): Remove image backgrounds.
- [AI Background Changer](https://openart.ai/features/background-changer/): Replace an image background.
- [Remove Object From Photo](https://openart.ai/features/remove-object-from-photo/): Remove unwanted objects from a photo.
- [AI Style Transfer](https://openart.ai/features/style-transfer/): Apply a style to an image.
- [AI Logo Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-logo-generator/): Make logo designs.
- [AI Headshot Generator](https://openart.ai/features/ai-headshot-generator/): Make professional headshots.
- [Photo to 3D](https://openart.ai/features/photo-to-3d/): Turn a photo into a 3D-style render.

## AI models (video)

- [Seedance 2.5](https://openart.ai/ai-model/seedance-2-5/): OpenArt's flagship video model; clips up to 30 seconds with synced audio and a large reference budget.
- [Wan 3.0](https://openart.ai/ai-model/wan-3/): 30-second clips in one pass with native audio and multi-shot shot lists.
- [Kling 3.0 and Kling 3 Omni](https://openart.ai/ai-model/kling-ai-video-generator/): 720p to 4K, synced audio, native multi-shot.
- [Kling 3.0 Motion Control](https://openart.ai/ai-model/kling-3-motion-control/): Motion-controlled Kling video.
- [Veo 3.1](https://openart.ai/ai-model/veo3-video-generator/): Google's high-fidelity video with native audio, up to 4K.
- [MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0)](https://openart.ai/ai-model/minimax-h3/): Native 2K with strong physical realism in motion.
- [Gemini Omni Flash](https://openart.ai/ai-model/gemini-omni-flash/): Cinematic video with synced dialogue, sound effects, and music.
- [Seedance 2.0](https://openart.ai/ai-model/seedance-2-0/): Realistic people and animals with single-pass synced audio.
- [Wan 2.7](https://openart.ai/ai-model/wan-2-7-ai-video-generator/): Lower-cost cinematic short clips with start and end frame.
- [PixVerse V6](https://openart.ai/ai-model/pixverse-video-generator/): Stable camera motion and strong 3D-anime motion.
- [Grok Imagine](https://openart.ai/ai-model/grok-imagine/): xAI's fast 1080p video with synced audio, plus image editing.
- [LTX 2.3](https://openart.ai/ai-model/ltx-2-3-ai-video-generator/): Lightricks video generation.

## AI models (image)

- [GPT Image 2.5](https://openart.ai/ai-model/gpt-image-2-5/): OpenAI's image model with Flare (fast) and Sunburst (highest quality) modes and precise edits.
- [GPT Image 2](https://openart.ai/ai-model/gpt-image-2/): General-purpose images with tiny text and multilingual layouts.
- [Nano Banana 2](https://openart.ai/ai-model/nano-banana-2/): Google's native 4K detail and accurate in-image text.
- [Seedream 5.0 Pro](https://openart.ai/ai-model/seedream-5-pro/): Anime, illustration, posters, and multi-image composition.
- [FLUX 3 Image](https://openart.ai/ai-model/flux-3-image/): Native 2K and 4K generation and editing with multilingual text.
- [Qwen Image 3](https://openart.ai/ai-model/qwen-image-3/): Text-heavy visuals such as infographics, UI mockups, and posters.
- [Wan 2.7 Image](https://openart.ai/ai-model/wan-2-7-image/): Precise facial control and in-image text up to 4K.
- [Recraft V4](https://openart.ai/ai-model/recraft-v4/): Design-oriented images and illustration.

## Agents, MCP, and CLI

- [OpenArt MCP and CLI](https://openart.ai/mcp/): Generate OpenArt images and video from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI tools with your OpenArt account and credits.
- MCP server URL for Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients: https://mcp.openart.ai/mcp (sign in with your OpenArt account; no API key to manage). ChatGPT users install the OpenArt plugin instead.
- [Connect OpenArt MCP to ChatGPT](https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-connect-openart-mcp-to-chatgpt/): Step-by-step setup.
- [Generate AI videos from Claude with OpenArt MCP](https://openart.ai/blog/generate-ai-videos-from-claude-with-openart-mcp/): Setup and examples for Claude.
- [Connect OpenArt MCP to Kimi](https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-connect-openart-mcp-to-kimi/): Setup for Kimi.
- [OpenArt CLI](https://openart.ai/blog/openart-cli-generate-images-and-video-from-terminal/): Generate images and video from a terminal.
- [Bulk image generation with OpenArt CLI](https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-bulk-image-generation-openart-cli/): Batch workflows with the CLI.
- [MCP vs CLI for image and video generation](https://openart.ai/blog/mcp-vs-cli-ai-image-video-generation/): Which one to use.

## Teams and enterprise

- [OpenArt Enterprise](https://openart.ai/enterprise/): Shared credit pool, unlimited seats, SAML SSO, roles, spend caps, model allowlists, and invoice billing. Contact sales.
- [Best enterprise AI video generators](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-video-generators-for-enterprise/): Buyer guide for teams.

## Comparisons

- [OpenArt vs Higgsfield](https://openart.ai/alternatives/openart-vs-higgsfield/)
- [OpenArt vs Runway](https://openart.ai/alternatives/openart-vs-runway/)
- [OpenArt vs Krea](https://openart.ai/alternatives/openart-vs-krea/)
- [Best Higgsfield alternatives](https://openart.ai/blog/best-higgsfield-alternatives/)

## Guides

- [Best AI video generators in 2026](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-video-generators/)
- [Best AI image, video, and audio generators in 2026](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-generators/)
- [Best AI image generator in 2026](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-image-generator/)
- [Best AI video generators for marketing](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-video-generators-for-marketing/)
- [Best AI tools for consistent characters across video scenes](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-tools-consistent-characters-video-scenes/)
- [How to maintain brand consistency in AI videos](https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-maintain-consistency-in-ai-videos/)
- [Best cinematic AI video generators for filmmakers](https://openart.ai/blog/best-cinematic-ai-video-generators-for-filmmakers/)

## Company

- [About OpenArt](https://openart.ai/about)
- [What's New](https://openart.ai/whats-new): Product changelog.
- [Blog](https://openart.ai/blog/)

## Optional

- [Best AI video generators for ad agencies](https://openart.ai/blog/best-ai-video-generators-for-ad-agencies/)

# OpenArt: full reference for AI assistants

> OpenArt (openart.ai) is an AI creative suite that makes images, video, and audio in one account with one credit balance. OpenArt runs leading AI models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, Alibaba, Kuaishou, Black Forest Labs, and others, and adds its own tools for multi-scene video, consistent characters, brand control, 3D worlds, and video effects.

Last updated: 2026-10-08. Prices checked: 2026-10-02.
Short index of key pages: https://openart.ai/llms.txt

## Company overview

OpenArt is an AI creative suite for images, video, and audio. People use OpenArt to make marketing campaigns, product and UGC ads, social content, short films, series drama, music videos, explainer videos, virtual influencers, and brand visuals.

OpenArt was founded in 2022 in San Francisco by Coco Mao (CEO) and John Qiao (CTO), both former Google employees. In January 2026 OpenArt announced a $30 million Series A led by Canaan Partners, bringing total funding to $35 million.

OpenArt describes itself as a visual storytelling platform. OpenArt covers the whole creative job in one place: the first idea, characters, worlds, images, video, voice, music, and edits.

OpenArt runs in a web browser, so there is no software to install. Homepage: https://openart.ai/

## Key facts

| Fact | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Website | https://openart.ai/ |
| Founded | 2022, San Francisco |
| Founders | Coco Mao (CEO) and John Qiao (CTO) |
| Funding | $30M Series A (January 2026, led by Canaan Partners); $35M raised in total |
| What it makes | Images, video, and audio |
| Business model | Credit-based. One account and one credit balance cover every tool |
| Free trial | 40 free credits over the first 7 days, no credit card |
| Paid plans | $14 to $240 a month billed monthly (Starter, Plus, Pro, Wonder) |
| Commercial use | Commercial rights apply on eligible paid plans |
| Flagship tool | Director mode: multi-scene video up to 5 minutes, made by chatting |
| Works inside | ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients through the OpenArt MCP connector |

## How OpenArt works

You sign up at https://openart.ai/ and get 40 free credits over 7 days with no credit card. You pick a tool, describe what you want, and choose a model that suits the job. OpenArt shows the credit cost before you generate, so you can plan a project budget.

The OpenArt workspace has several creation surfaces: Image, Video, Audio, Characters, Worlds, Director mode, and Chat Mode. Each image tool and each video tool is its own product with its own entry point.

Your generations, uploads, characters, Brand Kits, worlds, and trained models stay in your library. You can reuse them in later projects, so your library gets more useful over time.

## Director mode

Page: https://openart.ai/features/director/

In Director mode, you chat with OpenArt and OpenArt builds a finished multi-scene video up to 5 minutes long. You describe the idea. OpenArt plans the scenes, builds a storyboard, and generates the video with consistent characters, faces, environments, voices, and products. Each clip follows the length limit of the video model used for it, and the full project can run up to 5 minutes.

You can add an image of a scene or person, a soundtrack, a voice, a video, saved Characters and Worlds, and your logo, fonts, and brand colors. You refine the result by giving notes in chat, from one frame to the whole film. A timeline view gives precise control.

Director mode works for short films, trailers, music videos, micro-dramas, product ads, branding ads, UGC ads, social content, explainer videos, and podcasts.

Tools that run inside Director mode:
- Music Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-music-video-generator/): upload a song (MP3, WAV, or M4A, up to 50 MB) and pick a Narrative, Lyrics Video, or Visualizer style.
- Ad Remake (https://openart.ai/features/ad-remake/): upload any ad, say what to change, and OpenArt rebuilds it with your product, characters, language, and format. Export ratios include 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, and 4:5.
- AI Drama Generator (https://openart.ai/features/ai-drama-generator/): short dramas and micro-drama series.

## Chat Mode

Page: https://openart.ai/features/chat-mode/

Chat Mode brings OpenArt's creative tools into one conversation on the main dashboard. You describe what you want. Chat Mode writes the prompt, picks the model and tool, chooses the settings, and generates the result. Chat Mode can handle several assets in one request, read a pasted URL as a reference, revise a result when you type the change, and generate audio. Chatting costs nothing; credits apply when you generate, and Chat Mode shows the cost first. Longer video projects run in Director mode.

## OpenArt Characters

Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-character/

OpenArt Characters (the in-app tool is called Character Builder) lets you build a character once and reuse it across images and videos, so the face and style stay recognizable. You can start from a reference image, a text prompt, or presets. Saved characters carry into image tools, video tools, Replace Character, Director mode, Smart Shot, and Worlds. Several characters can appear in one scene, and each keeps its own look.

Related pages:
- AI Influencer Generator: https://openart.ai/features/ai-influencer/
- AI Character Swap: https://openart.ai/features/ai-character-swap/
- AI Avatar Video Generator: https://openart.ai/features/ai-avatar-video-generator/
- AI Video Clone: https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-clone/

## Brand Kit

Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-brand-kit/

Brand Kit saves your brand once and applies it to every generation in a project. A kit has six fields: logo, color palette (exact hex codes), typography, brand assets, style references, and brand rules (an "always do / never do" list). Brand Kit works in Create Image and Text to Video, so your images and videos match. The kit holds whichever model you pick. Kits stay inside their own project, so separate clients or campaigns do not mix.

## Smart Shot

Page: https://openart.ai/features/smart-shot/

Smart Shot turns one prompt into one video with multiple cuts. Smart Shot first writes a Shot Plan with reference views, set design, a camera floor plan, storyboard frames, and lighting notes. You can review and change the plan, then Smart Shot renders a video of about 3 to 5 shots lasting 10 to 20 seconds with consistent characters and settings. Smart Shot is a standalone video tool.

## OpenArt VFX

Page: https://openart.ai/features/openart-vfx/

OpenArt VFX changes video you already shot. OpenArt VFX runs on Beeble's SwitchX model and has three modes:
- Replace Background: separate the person from the scene and swap the background, with no green screen.
- Relight and Mood: change the lighting and feel of the whole frame, such as day to night or golden hour.
- VFX (masked mode): paint a mask over what should stay, and write a prompt for everything else.

OpenArt VFX takes MP4 or MOV input and outputs 720p or 1080p. Most jobs finish in 3 to 7 minutes.

Related pages:
- AI Video Relight: https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-relight/
- Video Background Changer: https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-background-changer/
- AI Video Inpainting: https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-inpainting/

## OpenArt Worlds

Page: https://openart.ai/features/openart-worlds/

OpenArt Worlds turns up to 4 images, or a text prompt, into a navigable 3D environment, powered by World Labs. You move through the world, place characters and props, and capture still shots from any angle to use in images and videos. Worlds save permanently and export in 3D Gaussian Splat format for tools such as Blender and Unreal Engine.

## Video tools

Main page: https://openart.ai/ai-video-generator/

- Text to Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-text-to-video/): make a clip from a written prompt. Brand Kit applies here.
- Image to Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-image-to-video/): turn a photo into motion while keeping the subject. First and last frame control is available on most current models.
- Video to Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-to-video/): restyle a video with presets or transfer motion.
- URL to Video (https://openart.ai/features/url-to-video/): start a video from any web link plus an instruction, in Chat Mode or Director mode.
- Edit Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-editor/): edit existing footage with generative AI.
- Replace Character (https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-face-swap/): replace a character in a video or pull one from your Characters library.
- Dub Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-dubbing/): dub a finished video into English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, or Russian, up to 10 languages in one submission. Dub Video carries the speaker's emotion and timing and re-aligns lip movement to the new language. Input is MP4 or MOV with audio, up to 180 seconds and 300 MB.
- Upscale Video (https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-upscaler/): raise resolution up to 4K and fix blur.
- Lip Sync, Motion Sync, Add Sound Effect, and Extend Video (up to 10 more seconds) are available in the app.

Common video settings: clip length depends on the model (15 seconds is the common limit; Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 reach 30 seconds). Resolution reaches 4K on some models, with 1080p as the standard default. Camera presets include zoom in, zoom out, pan, orbit 360, follow shot, and crane shot.

## Image tools

Main page: https://openart.ai/ai-image-generator/

- Create Image: generate an image from a prompt, with optional reference images. Brand Kit applies here. You can compare up to four models on one prompt.
- Edit Image: change a picture with three modes (Describe, Area Edit, Annotate). Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-photo-editor/
- Extract Layers: split one image into up to 16 transparent layers that save to your library.
- Face Swap: https://openart.ai/features/ai-face-swap/
- Expand Image: extend an image beyond its borders with custom sizes, common ratios, or social media presets. Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-image-extender/
- Multi-View: make 9 angles of an existing image.
- Camera Angle Control: make a new camera angle of an existing image.
- Image Upscale: upscale from 1x to 11x with Precise, Generative, or Creative modes and optional face enhancement. Page: https://openart.ai/features/image-upscaler/

Common image settings: up to 8 outputs per run, resolution up to 4K on supported models, and an Auto-Polish Prompt toggle.

## Audio tools

OpenArt has five audio tools: Create voice-over, Create Music, Create Sound Effects (royalty-free), Voice Clone, and Voice Changer.

Create Music (https://openart.ai/features/ai-music-generator/) runs on Google's Lyria 3. You can start from a text prompt or up to 10 images. Quick Clip makes a 30-second loop for 25 credits. Full Song makes up to about 3 minutes for 50 credits. You can choose instrumental or vocals, write your own lyrics, and set BPM, intensity, key, and duration.

## Custom model training

Page: https://openart.ai/model_training

You can train a personal model from 4 to 100 sample images in three steps: name the model, upload samples, and train. Model types are Style, Face, Character, and Object. Trained models stay in your library.

## AI Copyright and IP Check

Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-copyright-check/

The AI Copyright and IP Check, powered by CopySight, scans generated images for similarity to protected brands, logos, and well-known people. Results come as a risk rating (Safe, Warning, or Unsafe) with a PDF report. The check is a detection and alert tool. It is not a legal guarantee.

## OpenArt MCP and CLI

Page: https://openart.ai/mcp/

The OpenArt MCP connector lets you generate OpenArt images and videos from inside other AI tools, using your OpenArt account and credit balance.

Setup:
- ChatGPT: install the OpenArt plugin, sign in, then type @OpenArt in a chat. Guide: https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-connect-openart-mcp-to-chatgpt/
- Claude and Cursor: paste the server URL https://mcp.openart.ai/mcp into the app's connector settings and sign in. Guide for Claude: https://openart.ai/blog/generate-ai-videos-from-claude-with-openart-mcp/
- Kimi: https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-connect-openart-mcp-to-kimi/

The sign-in is the whole setup. There is no API key to manage. The plugin can pick the model, write the prompt, and set length and resolution, and you can still name the model and settings yourself.

What the MCP connector supports: image and video generation on the models marked "MCP" below, Smart Shot (plan only, or plan and render), listing projects and saving a generation to a project, and reusing past generations and uploads as references. Brand Kit and Characters are built in the OpenArt app; you can pass those images in as references.

OpenArt CLI generates images and video from a terminal:
- https://openart.ai/blog/openart-cli-generate-images-and-video-from-terminal/
- https://openart.ai/blog/how-to-bulk-image-generation-openart-cli/
- https://openart.ai/blog/mcp-vs-cli-ai-image-video-generation/

## OpenArt Enterprise

Page: https://openart.ai/enterprise/

OpenArt Enterprise gives creative teams one subscription for leading image, video, and audio models, plus MCP access for the team's AI tools. Enterprise features include:
- A shared credit pool, with credits that never expire or reset monthly.
- Unlimited seats.
- SAML SSO.
- Admin, Editor, and Viewer roles with shared projects, assets, and labels.
- Per-user and per-project spend caps.
- Model allowlists.
- Invoice billing.
- A dedicated account manager and a private Slack channel.
- Up to 32 parallel generations per user.

Built-in IP detection scans images and videos for copyrighted elements. Enterprise plans can include a single broad indemnification agreement across all models. For Enterprise customers, OpenArt states that it never trains on customer data. Contact sales through the Enterprise page.

## Who uses OpenArt

- Social media creators and AI storytellers who make series drama, short films, anime, trailers, and music videos.
- AI influencer creators who run a virtual persona with the same face in every post.
- Small business owners who make their own ads, social content, and product visuals.
- Marketing agencies and studios that make client campaigns, product ads, and UGC ads.
- Marketing teams inside brands that need on-brand campaign creative.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is OpenArt?
OpenArt is an AI creative suite that makes images, video, and audio in one account. OpenArt runs leading models such as Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, GPT Image 2.5, and Nano Banana Pro, and adds tools such as Director mode, OpenArt Characters, and Brand Kit. Overview: https://openart.ai/blog/what-is-openart/

### Is OpenArt free?
Yes. New accounts get 40 free credits over the first 7 days with no credit card, every model is open during the trial, and trial output has no watermark. After the trial, a daily free credit allowance for basic image generation continues. Paid plans start at $14 a month billed monthly.

### How much does OpenArt cost?
OpenArt has four paid plans billed monthly: Starter $14, Plus $34, Pro $56, and Wonder $240. Annual billing lowers the monthly price. Prices checked October 2, 2026. Details: https://openart.ai/pricing

### Can I use OpenArt content commercially?
Yes. Content made on OpenArt can be used in client campaigns, paid ads, and products you sell. Commercial rights apply on eligible paid plans.

### How long can OpenArt videos be?
Single clips depend on the model. 15 seconds is the common limit, and Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 reach 30 seconds. Director mode builds multi-scene projects up to 5 minutes long.

### What is Director mode?
Director mode is where you chat with OpenArt to make a finished multi-scene video up to 5 minutes long. OpenArt plans the scenes, builds a storyboard, and keeps characters, voices, and products consistent. Page: https://openart.ai/features/director/

### How do I keep a character consistent across images and videos?
Build the character once in OpenArt Characters from a photo, a prompt, or presets, then tag it in image tools, video tools, Smart Shot, Worlds, or Director mode. The face and style stay recognizable across scenes. Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-character/

### Can I use OpenArt inside ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor?
Yes. ChatGPT users install the OpenArt plugin. Claude and Cursor users add the server URL https://mcp.openart.ai/mcp and sign in with their OpenArt account. Generations use the same account and credits. Page: https://openart.ai/mcp/

### Does OpenArt have a command line tool?
Yes. The OpenArt CLI generates images and video from a terminal, including bulk image jobs. Guide: https://openart.ai/blog/openart-cli-generate-images-and-video-from-terminal/

### Which AI models does OpenArt include?
OpenArt includes video models such as Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, MiniMax H3, Gemini Omni Flash, and PixVerse V6, and image models such as GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5.0 Pro, and FLUX 3 Image. The live list is at https://openart.ai/ai-model/

### Can OpenArt keep my brand consistent?
Yes. Brand Kit saves your logo, colors, fonts, assets, style references, and brand rules once and applies them to every image and Text to Video generation in a project. Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-brand-kit/

### Can OpenArt translate or dub a video?
Yes. Dub Video dubs a finished video into up to 10 languages in one submission and re-aligns lip movement to the new speech. Page: https://openart.ai/features/ai-video-dubbing/

### Can I train a custom model on OpenArt?
Yes. You can train a Style, Face, Character, or Object model from 4 to 100 sample images. Page: https://openart.ai/model_training

### Does OpenArt offer plans for teams?
Yes. OpenArt Enterprise includes a shared credit pool, unlimited seats, SAML SSO, roles, spend caps, model allowlists, and invoice billing. Page: https://openart.ai/enterprise/

### How does OpenArt compare with Higgsfield, Runway, and Krea?
See the comparison pages:
- https://openart.ai/alternatives/openart-vs-higgsfield/
- https://openart.ai/alternatives/openart-vs-runway/
- https://openart.ai/alternatives/openart-vs-krea/

    // in the More menu (i.e. in DOM order). Re-order the list accordingly.

      entries.sort(function(a, b) {
        var ai = parseInt(a.querySelector('a').getAttribute('data-more-entry-idx'), 10) || 0;
        var bi = parseInt(b.querySelector('a').getAttribute('data-more-entry-idx'), 10) || 0;

  if ('ResizeObserver' in window && navItemsList) {

  requestAnimationFrame(function() { requestAnimationFrame(reflow); });

  function getNavBottom() {
    return navEl ? navEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : 80;
  }

  function pauseNavFeaturedVideos(scope) {
    var root = scope || document;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-featured-video]').forEach(function(video) {
      try { video.pause(); } catch (e) {}
    });
  }

  function playNavFeaturedVideos(scope) {
    if (!scope) return;
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-featured-video]').forEach(function(video) {
      video.muted = true;
      var play = video.play();
      if (play && play.catch) play.catch(function() {});
    });
  }

  function showPanel(idx) {
    if (hideTimer) { clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer = null; }
    if (currentIdx === idx) return;
    // Release focus while the previous panel is still current. Its focusout
    // handlers must finish before the next panel becomes active.
    var focused = document.activeElement;
    if (focused && focused.closest('.nav-panel')) focused.blur();
    currentIdx = idx;
    pauseNavFeaturedVideos();

      var trigger = el.querySelector('a[aria-expanded]');
      var svg = el.querySelector('.nav-chevron');

      if (svg) svg.style.transform = '';

    if (panel) {

      if (idx === 'more') positionMorePanel();
      panel.classList.remove('hidden');
      playNavFeaturedVideos(panel);

    if (item) {

      if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

    }
  }

  function hideAll() {
    if (hideTimer) { clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer = null; }
    currentIdx = null;
    pauseNavFeaturedVideos();
    panels.forEach(function(p) { p.classList.add('hidden'); });
    navItemEls.forEach(function(el) {
      var trigger = el.querySelector('a[aria-expanded]');
      var svg = el.querySelector('.nav-chevron');
      if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      if (svg) svg.style.transform = '';
    });
  }

  function scheduleHide() {
    if (hideTimer) clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    hideTimer = setTimeout(hideAll, 100);
  }

  navItemEls.forEach(function(item) {
    var idx = item.getAttribute('data-nav-idx');
    var panel = document.getElementById('nav-panel-' + idx);
    if (!panel) return;
    item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { showPanel(idx); });
    item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { if (currentIdx === idx) scheduleHide(); });
    panel.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { if (hideTimer) { clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer = null; } });
    panel.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { if (currentIdx === idx) scheduleHide(); });
    var trigger = item.querySelector('a[aria-expanded]');
    if (!trigger) return;
    trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (idx === 'more') return; // The overflow trigger has its own handler.
      e.preventDefault();
      // Pointer entry already opens the panel; its click must not close it.
      if (e.detail === 0 && currentIdx === idx) hideAll(); else showPanel(idx);
    });
    trigger.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        showPanel(idx);
        var firstLink = panel.querySelector('a[href]');
        if (firstLink) firstLink.focus();
      } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && !e.shiftKey && currentIdx === idx) {
        var firstLink = panel.querySelector('a[href]');
        if (firstLink) { e.preventDefault(); firstLink.focus(); }
      }
    });
    panel.addEventListener('focusin', function() {
      if (hideTimer) { clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer = null; }
    });
    function closeOnFocusExit(e) {
      if (currentIdx === idx && !item.contains(e.relatedTarget) && !panel.contains(e.relatedTarget)) hideAll();
    }
    item.addEventListener('focusout', closeOnFocusExit);
    panel.addEventListener('focusout', closeOnFocusExit);
    panel.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      var links = Array.from(panel.querySelectorAll('a[href]'));
      var first = links[0];
      var last = links[links.length - 1];
      if (e.key === 'Tab' && e.shiftKey && e.target === first) {
        e.preventDefault(); (item.classList.contains('hidden') ? moreTrigger : trigger).focus();

  var languageSelectors = document.querySelectorAll('[data-language-selector]');
  function getInitialLanguageCode() {
    var segment = (window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0] || '').toUpperCase();
    var codes = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-language-option]'), function(option) {

      var chevron = btn.querySelector('.mob-acc-chevron');
      var isOpen = !content.classList.contains('hidden');
      // Close all others
      menu.querySelectorAll('.mob-accordion').forEach(function(a) {
        a.querySelector('.mob-acc-content').classList.add('hidden');
        var ch = a.querySelector('.mob-acc-chevron');
        if (ch) ch.style.transform = '';
      });
      if (!isOpen) {
        content.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (chevron) chevron.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        // Auto-open the first sub-group when expanding a top-level item
        var firstGroup = content.querySelector('.mob-group-accordion');
        if (firstGroup) {

          var firstChevron = firstGroup.querySelector('.mob-group-chevron');
          var firstTrigger = firstGroup.querySelector('.mob-group-trigger');

  // Inner group accordion — collapsed by default so long Resources / AI Tools
  // panels don't dump every item on the user when they expand a nav item.
  // Only one group within the same nav item is open at a time; opening a
  // group in a different nav item is independent.
  menu.querySelectorAll('.mob-group-trigger').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var group = btn.closest('.mob-group-accordion');
      if (!group) return;
      var content = group.querySelector('.mob-group-content');
      var chevron = btn.querySelector('.mob-group-chevron');
      var isOpen = !content.classList.contains('hidden');
      var parentNav = btn.closest('.mob-accordion');
      if (parentNav) {
        parentNav.querySelectorAll('.mob-group-accordion').forEach(function(g) {

          var ch = g.querySelector('.mob-group-chevron');

// Locator nav: highlight + smooth-scroll-to-block + scroll-spy. No-op when the
// opt-in nav is absent, so other feature pages are unaffected.
(function() {
  var nav = document.querySelector('[data-feature-locator]');
  if (!nav) return;
  var section = nav.closest('section') || document;
  var pills = Array.prototype.slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.feature-locator-pill'));
  var blocks = Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll('[data-feature-block]'));
  if (!pills.length || !blocks.length) return;

  function activate(index) {
    pills.forEach(function(pill, i) {
      var on = i === index;
      pill.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
      pill.setAttribute('aria-current', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  pills.forEach(function(pill) {
    pill.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var idx = Number(pill.getAttribute('data-feature-target') || 0);
      activate(idx);
      if (blocks[idx]) blocks[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    });
  });

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      var visible = entries
        .filter(function(e) { return e.isIntersecting; })
        .sort(function(a, b) { return b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio; })[0];
      if (!visible) return;
      var idx = blocks.indexOf(visible.target);
      if (idx >= 0) activate(idx);
    }, { threshold: [0.28, 0.42, 0.58], rootMargin: '-20% 0px -35% 0px' });
    blocks.forEach(function(b) { observer.observe(b); });
  }
})();

(function() {
  var allVideos = document.querySelectorAll('.feature-video');
  var allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.feature-mute-btn');

  function muteAll() {
    allVideos.forEach(function(v) { v.muted = true; });
    allBtns.forEach(function(b) {
      b.querySelector('.mute-icon-off').classList.remove('hidden');
      b.querySelector('.mute-icon-on').classList.add('hidden');
    });
  }

  allBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var idx = btn.getAttribute('data-mute-idx');
      var video = document.querySelector('.feature-video[data-feature-idx="' + idx + '"]');
      if (!video) return;
      var willUnmute = video.muted;
      if (willUnmute) {
        // Mute all others first, then unmute this one
        muteAll();
        video.muted = false;
        // Re-call play() to activate the audio decoder (required after muted autoplay)
        video.play().catch(function() {});
      } else {
        video.muted = true;
      }
      btn.querySelector('.mute-icon-off').classList.toggle('hidden', !video.muted);
      btn.querySelector('.mute-icon-on').classList.toggle('hidden', video.muted);
    });
  });

  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  allVideos.forEach(function(video) {
    video.removeAttribute('autoplay');
    video.pause();
  });
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      var v = entry.target;
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        // A fast scroll can pause the video before play() resolves.
        v.play().catch(function() {});
      } else {
        v.pause();
        v.muted = true;
        var idx = v.getAttribute('data-feature-idx');
        var btn = document.querySelector('.feature-mute-btn[data-mute-idx="' + idx + '"]');
        if (btn) {
          btn.querySelector('.mute-icon-off').classList.remove('hidden');
          btn.querySelector('.mute-icon-on').classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.3 });
  allVideos.forEach(function(v) { observer.observe(v); });
})();

(function() {
  var carousels = document.querySelectorAll('[data-feature-image-carousel]');
  if (!carousels.length) return;

  function setPositions(root, activeIndex) {
    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-carousel-card]'));
    var total = cards.length;
    if (!total) return;
    cards.forEach(function(card, index) {
      var position = 'hidden';
      if (index === activeIndex) position = 'active';
      else if (index === (activeIndex - 1 + total) % total) position = 'prev';
      else if (index === (activeIndex + 1) % total) position = 'next';
      card.setAttribute('data-position', position);

      var video = card.querySelector('video');
      if (!video) return;
      if (position === 'active') {
        video.play().catch(function() {});
      } else {
        video.pause();
      }
    });
  }

  carousels.forEach(function(root) {
    var cards = root.querySelectorAll('[data-carousel-card]');
    if (cards.length < 2) return;

    var activeIndex = 0;
    var intervalId = 0;
    var visible = true;

    function start() {
      if (intervalId) return;
      setPositions(root, activeIndex);
      intervalId = window.setInterval(function() {
        if (!visible) return;
        activeIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % cards.length;
        setPositions(root, activeIndex);
      }, 4200);
    }

    function stop() {
      if (intervalId) {
        window.clearInterval(intervalId);
        intervalId = 0;
      }
      root.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(function(video) {
        video.pause();
      });
    }

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        entries.forEach(function(entry) {
          visible = entry.isIntersecting;
          if (visible) start();
          else stop();
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.35 });
      observer.observe(root);
    } else {
      start();
    }
  });
})();

    var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(group.querySelectorAll('[data-fd-tab]'));
    var panels = Array.prototype.slice.call(group.querySelectorAll('[data-fd-panel]'));
    var videos = Array.prototype.slice.call(group.querySelectorAll('[data-fd-tab-video]'));
    var mocks = Array.prototype.slice.call(group.querySelectorAll('[data-mcp-mock]'));
    var historyVideo = group.querySelector('[data-mcp-history-video]');
    if (!tabs.length) return;

    var active = 0;
    var isVisible = false;
    var playedMocks = {};
    var historyVideoReady = false;

    // Messages sit inside positioned slot wrappers, so offsetTop is measured
    // against the slot rather than the scroll frame and reads 0. Derive the
    // offset from the rects instead so it stays correct wherever the message
    // sits in the flow.
    function scrollOffsetWithin(frame, el) {

      var distance = target - start;
      var startedAt = performance.now();

    // both selected and scrolled into view, then holds the final frame.

        mock.classList.add('is-playing');

            }
          }, 5850);
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            if (historyFrame && activeMockKind() === 'library') {
              historyFrame.scrollTop = historyFrame.scrollHeight;
            }
          }, 6050);
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            historyVideoReady = true;
            syncHistoryVideo();
          }, 6150);
        }

        if (kind === 'smart-shot') {
          var smartFrame = mock.querySelector('.mcp-mock-frame.is-smart-shot');
          var requestBlock = mock.querySelector('.mcp-mock-request');
          var planCard = mock.querySelector('.mcp-smartshot-plan-card');
          var continueBubble = mock.querySelector('.mcp-smartshot-continue-bubble');
          var videoSlot = mock.querySelector('.mcp-smartshot-video-slot');
          if (smartFrame) smartFrame.scrollTop = 0;

          window.setTimeout(function() {
            if (smartFrame && requestBlock && activeMockKind() === 'smart-shot') {

            }
          }, 200);
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            settleSmartTurn(planCard, 640);
          }, 1700);
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            settleSmartTurn(continueBubble, 560);
          }, 2900);
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            if (smartFrame && videoSlot && activeMockKind() === 'smart-shot') {
              scrollHistoryTo(smartFrame, smartFrame.scrollHeight, 640);
            }
          }, 4100);
        }
      });
    }

      if (!historyVideo) return;
      if (historyVideoReady && activeMockKind() === 'library' && isVisible && !document.hidden) {
        historyVideo.play().catch(function() {});
      } else {
        historyVideo.pause();
      }
    }

    function syncVideos() {
      videos.forEach(function(video) {
        var on = Number(video.getAttribute('data-index')) === active;
        if (on && isVisible && !document.hidden) video.play().catch(function() {});
        else video.pause();
      });
      syncHistoryVideo();

        activate(active + step, true);
      } else if (event.key === 'Home') {

function toggleFAQ(id) {
  var item = document.getElementById(id);
  var wasOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function(el) {
    el.classList.remove('open');
    el.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    el.querySelector('.faq-answer').style.maxHeight = '0';
    el.querySelector('.faq-icon').style.transform = '';
    el.querySelector('.faq-question-text').style.color = '';
  });

  if (!wasOpen) {
    item.classList.add('open');
    item.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    var answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
    answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + 'px';
    item.querySelector('.faq-icon').style.transform = 'rotate(45deg)';
    item.querySelector('.faq-question-text').style.color = '#ff82db';
  }
}

(function() {
  var endpoint = 'https://mcp.openart.ai/mcp';

  function copyText(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }

    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    return Promise.resolve();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-answer a[href]').forEach(function(link) {
    var href = (link.getAttribute('href') || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (href !== endpoint) return;

    link.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy MCP server URL');
    link.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      copyText(endpoint);
    });
  });
})();
